targets.name: Custom teams in Exhibition
targets.why: Exhibition panel is not stripped and mentions no custom teams at all (verified negative over 3 panel name maps). The gate lives in the HUB/team-data objects (e.g. WBP_Team_Select_Team_Data). Dumping those needs a .usmap.
targets.unblocks: One Windows run with Dumper-7/UE4SS (or a full-memory minidump) to produce a .usmap.

targets.name: In-depth stadium editing (fields, configs, custom models, surface art)
targets.why: Registry recovered (36 stadiums, grass/seat color axes), but data-level edits need a .usmap to deserialize safely. Field surface art is NO LONGER blocked by .ubulk: Oodle library liboo2corelinux64.so.9 installed next to retoc Oct 25 2026, and retoc to-legacy now converts .ubulk textures (T_NoiseShape verified: Extracted 2, 0 failed, previously 0/2).
targets.unblocks: .usmap for data edits; texture round-trip for surface art now works via the pak lane.

targets.name: In-depth editing of DEFAULT teams
targets.why: 186 DT_RosterTeamData_* tables are real player data (plaintext names, ~87 players/team), but row/field names and attribute boundaries are unrecoverable without a .usmap. Raw binary row editing is not sane.
targets.unblocks: .usmap, then dump -> edit JSON -> repack via the pak lane.

targets.name: Unlock all Season Pass equipment
targets.why: Exe patch built Oct 24 2026: 9 bytes, 3 sites in the BattlePass data loader (0x144e832af), forces cached tier=100 + status PremiumActive. Claimed arrays (+0x560/+0x570) NOT forced; server claim validation may still reject claims.
targets.unblocks: Joshua's in-game test on his play setup (back up original exe first).

targets.name: FREE LOGO PLACEMENT on equipment (any piece, any size, any position)
targets.why: DA_CustomizationUniformPartSymbols holds only 3 decals, no slot/UV data. The constraint is in the class/struct definition or materials/UI (MF_LogoProjection) — needs a .usmap to read.
targets.unblocks: .usmap, then dump the UniformPartSymbols class definition.
